title: Discover
desc: We learn your domain, users, constraints and edge cases before writing code, and agree on what success looks like.

title: Architect
desc: System design, data models, tenancy and security decisions are documented and challenged while changing them is still cheap.

title: Design
desc: Flows and interfaces designed as one system, with tokens, components and states that map directly to code.

title: Build
desc: Short iterations with regular demos. Code review, automated tests and CI/CD are part of the standard build.

title: Harden
desc: Load testing, security review and monitoring are done before launch, while fixing things is still cheap.

title: Launch & scale
desc: We support the rollout, monitor real usage and keep improving the product as it grows.
